card.name: Linking words before technical descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (for, to, like, by, including, a comma, an opening parenthesis) just before a technical or scientific term in descriptive prose. The next word is often a science or measurement-related term.

modes.label: Linking word before a science term
modes.description: A preposition or verb such as for, to, like or by that leads into a technical phrase.
modes.example: for their work leading<< to>> modern telecommunications

modes.label: List or parenthesis opener
modes.description: A comma, parenthesis or word like including that begins a list or abbreviation.

modes.description: A size word such as tiny placed before a physical object.
